html.body: Date: 2025-04-01 REMARKSThis is an Amendment After Allowance under 37 C.F.R. § 1.312 submitted after the Notice of Allowance dated February 28, 2025, but before payment of the Issue Fee.Applicant submits this 37 C.F.R. §1.312 amendment to correct matters of form, in particular, to correct typographical errors in paragraph [0010]. Applicant submits the amendments do not change the scope of the claims. Support for the amendment may be found in the originally- filed specification, claims, and figures. Applicant respectfully requests that the amendment be entered.Applicant acknowledges the Examiner's statements of reasons for allowance of the above- referenced patent application and agrees that the claimed subject matter is patentably distinct over the references cited. However, Applicant not taking a position regarding the reasons for allowance presented by the Examiner other than the positions Applicant may have previously taken during prosecution. Therefore, the Examiner's reasons for allowance should not be attributed to Applicant as an indication of the basis for Applicant's belief that the claims are patentably distinct.Furthermore, it is respectfully asserted that there may be additional reasons for patentability of the claimed subject matter not explicitly stated in this record and Applicant does not waive its rights to such arguments by not further addressing such reasons herein.CONCLUSIONIf there are any questions with regard to this Amendment, the Office is invited to contact the undersigned at the listed telephone number. The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any fees which may be required, or credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No. 192814 for any deficiency or overpayment in the fees required. This statement does NOT authorize charge of the issue fee.Respectfully submitted, Dated: April 1, 2025 By /Kelsey Hutchinson/ Kelsey Hutchinson, Reg.
